behaviour: Integration tests for DefaultEntitiesCatalog.entityRedirect covering single match, live entity precedence, ambiguity, and permission filters.
rules: 1. Add describe('entityRedirect', ...) inside the test suite in DefaultEntitiesCatalog.test.ts.
2. Test that a single stitched entity claiming a previous name via backstage.io/previous-names resolves { entityRef } for bare name, namespace/name, and kind:namespace/name.
3. Test that if a live stitched entity exists at the requested ref, entityRedirect returns undefined.
4. Test that if two stitched entities of the same kind claim the same previous name, entityRedirect returns undefined (unless a permission filter narrows the match to a single authorized entity).
5. Test that if the claimant entity does not match the request.filter FilterPredicate, entityRedirect returns undefined.
